title: From extensions to a running script
description: Extensions describe their Luau surface without a VM. The planner composes them, assigns every tag, atom and slot, and renders the type definitions. Each runtime built from the plan gets its own VM with that exact shape, and scripts run in sandboxes the host can measure.

nodes.title: Extension::describe
nodes.detail: Modules and their typed members, userdata types under stable keys with tag and compiler-slot policies, packed kinds, services, capabilities, memory categories, lowering hooks. No VM is touched.

nodes.title: RuntimePlan::finalize
nodes.detail: Orders extensions by dependency, merges owners with augmenters, assigns tags, Luau's 32 compiler slots, atoms and direct slots, validates every identifier and path, inserts the dream.net bridge, and renders the .d.luau.

nodes.title: Runtime::from_plan
nodes.detail: A VM with the planned metatables, generic direct-access callbacks, opened and frozen modules, each extension's install run in order, and compiler metadata for the compatibility globals. Any number of runtimes per plan.

nodes.title: Sandbox
nodes.detail: OpenMW's prelude, one environment per script instance cloned from a compiled template, the watchdog, memory categories and call scopes around every call.

nodes.title: Type definitions
nodes.detail: The plan's declare extern type grammar, served to Luau's analysis frontend and type checked against strict scripts in the crate's tests.

nodes.title: Native code
nodes.detail: With the jit feature, lowering hooks written in Rust compile annotated call sites to IR: quaternions, colours and vertex writes with no C call.
